claim_text: The May 20, 2026 Information in United States v. Fahima Egeh Mahamud alleges two program-specific dollar figures that must remain separate: Future Leaders received more than $850,000 in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds through Feeding Our Future between approximately January and July 2021, while Future Leaders submitted approximately $4.6 million in Child Care Assistance Program reimbursement claims between approximately October 2022 and December 2025 in the separate alleged co-payment scheme. The first figure is program funds received; the second is claims submitted. Neither is a proven-loss figure, and they should not be collapsed into a single Feeding Our Future loss total.

supporting_passages.quote: Future Leaders received more than $850,000 in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds
submitted claims for reimbursement from CCAP in the amount of approximately $4.6 million

amounts.methodology: Charging document states more than $850,000 received; $850,000 is stored as the stated threshold and must be displayed as more-than/approximate, not as an exact total.
Charging document states approximately $4.6 million in CCAP reimbursement claims; this is a claims figure, not automatically amount_paid or proven_loss.

qualifiers: The child-nutrition and CCAP figures concern different programs, periods, and alleged conduct
Do not sum these into a Feeding Our Future scheme-wide total
The $850,000 stored value represents a source-stated lower threshold ('more than'), not an exact amount
